# Folio

> Night archive of ongoing Pitchfork-and-Torch research desks. Hypothesis lab notes only.

- Site: https://folio.jonbailey.xyz/
- Author: @suddenlyjon / https://jonbailey.xyz/
- Version: 1.4.0
- License: MIT

## One-liner

Folio is a full-canvas 3D night scriptorium that presents public research desks. It currently holds Liber Primus notes, Voynich notes, a lectern for the INSTAR school, and a cipher gauntlet of burned methods. It is not a solve and not a translation.

## Desks

### Liber Primus
- Repo: https://github.com/Pitchfork-and-Torch/liber-research
- LP2 pages 0-55 remain unsolved (~12956 runes, IOC ~0.03448).
- LP1 and LP2 AN END / PARABLE are community-known calibration only.
- Not affiliated with Cicada 3301. Not a recruiter.

### Voynich
- Repo: https://github.com/Pitchfork-and-Torch/voynich-research
- Yale Beinecke MS 408. Hypothesis gloss only.
- EVA letters are not phonemes. No plant identified. No language identified.
- Passes 1-8 recorded. Herbal-A label gauntlet FAIL.

### INSTAR (The School)
- Live: https://instar.jonbailey.xyz/
- Seven-molt school for the cryptography Cicada actually used.
- Not affiliated. Not a recruiter. Not Liber Primus gematria.
- This hall lectern is a sign. Spoilers stay off Folio.

### Gauntlet (Desk 04)
- Repo: https://github.com/Pitchfork-and-Torch/liber-research
- Eight named families burned 2026-08-14: outguess, book-index, running-key, periodic, columnar, word-unit, acrostic, homophonic.
- All FAIL. No new 3301 English. No ninth family invented here. Do not recook.
- Receipts only. Not a new method.

## FAQ

### What is Folio?
A public 3D hall for ongoing research desks. Scroll walks the aisle.

### Did you solve Liber Primus?
No.

### Did you translate the Voynich manuscript?
No.

### Are the hanging pages real manuscript images?
No. They are invented set dressing. Public notes do not host Liber Primus JPEGs or Voynich folios.

### How do I read this without WebGL?
https://folio.jonbailey.xyz/a11y and the no-JS HTML on the homepage.
